messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated 5xx rate observed on Private VPC ILB egress path (eu-west1 -> us-central1) for customer traffic. Spike started ~1917004200, 35% 5xx over 15m baseline. Paging oncall.
Alex: acknowledging, looking. tagging @Samir oncall.
Samir: I'm up, grabbing it. any more context? which backend?
Alex: initial traces show failures at the ILB->auth-proxy hop, 401/502 mix. Logs show repeated token fetch errors: \`oauth-token-fetch failed: 429 rate_limited\`.
Samir: hmm 429 from third-party auth provider (KeylyAuth) when ILB healthcheck hits token endpoint? b/w, that provider reported degraded API on their status page earlier.
GCPStatusBot: GCP Cloud Load Balancing reports increased control-plane retries in eu-west1 for internal LB. Noted maintenance at 1917003000 affecting health-check propagation.
Leila: adding notes: affected customers are Private VPC deployments that rely on our auth-proxy to call KeylyAuth for short-lived tokens. If Keyly is throttling, auth-proxy returns 502 to ILB.
Jess: copying monitoring graphs to thread: `https://grafana.redwood.example/d/ilb/privvpc-5xx?from=1917003600&to=1917007200`
Samir: immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable token-cache fallback on auth-proxy, 2) route eu-west1 ILB healthchecks to regional token-cache, 3) temp increase retry/backoff to avoid hammering Keyly. I'll run the changes.
Alex: voted +1. Samir, do we have safe config toggle?
Samir: yes, patching auth-proxy config now. Applying: ```
# toggle token-cache fallback
feature.token_cache_fallback = true
retry.max_attempts = 5
retry.base_delay_ms = 300
```
Samir: patch applied to auth-proxy pool in eu-west1 (canary). watching logs.
Tina: watching from SRE. Are we going to fail open for refresh tokens? need approval from security.
Leila: quick sec — security ok with fallback for 1 hour under incident, logged and audited.
Samir: canary looks good: error rate for the canary nodes dropped to 4% 5xx. Rolling to remainder of eu-west1 auth-proxy.
Alex: notify customers? which ones seeing impact?
Jess: preliminary list from billing/usage: cust-A, cust-D, cust-F show increased errors. estimate ~12 customers across EU Private VPCs.
Samir: rolling now. updating routing to prefer local token cache for any cross-region token calls.
GCPStatusBot: Follow-up: internal LB control-plane backlog cleared at 1917006000 but we still see auth-provider 429s downstream.
Samir: after full roll, 5xxs reduced across eu-west1 ILBs to 2% — still seeing intermittent 502s where auth-proxy still receives 429s from Keyly.
Alex: reach out to Keyly support/public status — ask for ETA and request rate-limit bump for our service.
Samir: message sent to Keyly support (ticket #KLY-7823): "observed 429s/ratelimit affecting token endpoints for ~45min, requesting temporary allowance / mitigation".
Leila: can we short-term route affected customers to us-central1 regional fallback? Risk: added latency but better than 50% 5xx.
Samir: I can update smart-routing policy to failover eu-west1->us-central1 for those customers. Doing canary of 10% traffic.
Jess: customer comms draft: "We observed an upstream auth provider degradation causing elevated errors for Private VPC ILB customers in EU. We applied token-cache fallback and routing failovers; errors are decreasing. Monitoring and will follow up." approve?
Alex: approve, send to customers. Include incident link and mitigation steps.
IncidentBot: Incident created: INC-2026-0432 (priority P1). Pager rotation: Samir -> Leila in 2h.
Tina: monitoring dashboard shows end-to-end success rate improving. still watching Keyly ticket.
Samir: Keyly replied: they are experiencing regional token service overload; they applied a partial throttle lift for our tenant, full mitigation ETA 1h.
Leila: good. plan for next hour: 1) keep token-cache fallback, 2) maintain failover routing, 3) collect post-mortem artefacts (logs, prom queries, runbook steps).
Alex: confirm SLA/customer impact: we saw degraded success for ~45m, impact mostly request-level errors (5xx) for some Private VPC customers. No data plane exfiltration.
Jess: updated customer comms and sent to impacted list.
Samir: as part of mitigation I'm reverting the aggressive retry increase to normal but keeping caching on. also increasing circuit-breaker threshold to avoid saturating Keyly.
Samir: change set: ```
retry.max_attempts = 3
circuitbreaker.threshold = 50
```
GCPStatusBot: GCP ILB control-plane logs show normal propagation post 1917006000. No further LB anomalies.
Alex: summary for on-call handoff: token-provider (Keyly) caused 429s, we enabled token-cache fallback and regional routing failover, reduced 5xx from 35%->~2%. Customers impacted: ~12 Private VPC tenants, partial traffic failover occurred for 10% then gradually reverted. Incident state: monitoring.
Leila: taking handoff in 2h. will maintain watch and follow up with Keyly for timeline and post-incident report items.
Tina: noted, prepare postmortem template and collect runbook diffs.
Samir: leaving a playbook note: add alert for token-provider 429 ratio and circuit-breaker threshold so we can auto-failover sooner.
Alex: thanks all — keep thread updated.
Leila: marking status: mitigated -> monitoring. ETA for final closure: await Keyly full mitigation + 2h stable window.
IncidentBot: Paging out-of-hours rotation for oncall shift handoff to Leila at 1917011521.
Leila: acknowledged, will take over and open postmortem doc once Keyly confirms.
Samir: logging final metrics in incident ticket: pre-mitigation 5xx peak 38%, post-mitigation steady 1.8%.
Jess: uploaded screenshots and customer notify copies to INC-2026-0432.
Leila: thanks. closing active mitigation — moving to monitoring mode.
